scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm test -w apps/api && npm test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.lint: eslint apps/api/src apps/api/test apps/api/scripts apps/web/app apps/web/components apps/web/lib
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:mock -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
